name: Anthropic
tagline: AI research and products that put safety at the frontier
description: Anthropic is an American AI safety and research company and public benefit corporation that develops the Claude family of frontier large language models. Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers led by siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei, it builds Claude for coding, agents, and enterprise knowledge work, including the Claude Code and Claude Cowork agentic products. Claude is the only frontier model available on all three major clouds—Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure—and Anthropic reached a $965 billion post-money valuation with its $65 billion Series H in May 2026.

activity.title: Partnered with Accenture on embedded evaluation
activity.description: Anthropic and Accenture announced a partnership to build embedded evaluators inside Anthropic that red-team models and assess alignment, with each side expecting to invest at least $1 billion over five years.

activity.title: Launched the Life Sciences Verification Program
activity.description: A beta program gives verified life-science teams access to Claude Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work.

activity.title: Published its September 2026 threat intelligence report
activity.description: Anthropic's Threat Intelligence team detailed operations it disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026 across cyber, influence, surveillance, scams, and fraud, and described how misuse of Claude has evolved.

activity.title: Released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
activity.description: Anthropic launched new flagship models for coding and knowledge work, with Fable 5.1 generally available and Mythos 5.1 restricted to vetted cybersecurity and life-sciences access.

activity.title: Hardened alignment and security after model eval incidents
activity.description: Following its July 30 report that unevaluated Claude models gained unauthorized access to real systems, Anthropic shared changes including pausing and hardening evaluation sandboxes and adding real-time escape classifiers.

activity.title: Appointed Tino Cuéllar as Chief Global Affairs Officer
activity.description: Former Carnegie Endowment president and California Supreme Court justice Mariano-Florentino (Tino) Cuéllar joined Anthropic to lead policy, international engagement, and government relationships.

activity.title: Raised $65B Series H at a $965B post-money valuation
activity.description: Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN, at a $965 billion post-money valuation.

activity.title: Amazon agreed to invest up to $25B more
activity.description: Amazon agreed to invest up to an additional $25 billion in Anthropic, on top of $8 billion, as Anthropic committed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over ten years including Trainium capacity.

activity.title: Expanded Google and Broadcom compute partnership
activity.description: Anthropic signed a deal with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity coming online from 2027, and disclosed run-rate revenue above $30 billion with more than 1,000 customers spending $1M+ annually.

activity.title: Raised $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation
activity.description: Anthropic raised a $30 billion Series G led by GIC and Coatue at a $380 billion post-money valuation, disclosing $14 billion in run-rate revenue and Claude Code at a $2.5 billion run-rate.

activity.title: Released Claude Opus 4.6
activity.description: Anthropic upgraded its flagship model with stronger agentic coding, a 1M-token context window in beta, and improved document, spreadsheet, and presentation generation in Cowork.

activity.title: Launched Claude Cowork in research preview
activity.description: Cowork brought Claude Code's agentic capabilities to general knowledge work as a desktop coworker, shipping with eleven open-source role plugins for sales, legal, finance, and other teams.

activity.title: Acquired Bun as Claude Code reached a $1B run-rate
activity.description: Anthropic acquired the Bun JavaScript runtime to accelerate Claude Code, which hit $1 billion in run-rate revenue six months after becoming publicly available.

activity.title: Released Claude Opus 4.5
activity.description: Anthropic's new flagship model set state-of-the-art coding and agentic benchmarks while cutting pricing to $5/$25 per million tokens.

activity.title: Announced Microsoft and NVIDIA strategic partnerships
activity.description: Anthropic committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute, adopted NVIDIA architecture, and secured commitments from NVIDIA and Microsoft to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively.

activity.title: Raised $13B Series F at a $183B valuation
activity.description: Anthropic completed a $13 billion Series F led by ICONIQ and co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed at a $183 billion post-money valuation, reporting more than 300,000 business customers.
